title: Function helpers
hints: Each helper returns a new function that can still see a variable from the helper: a `Map` of results for `memoize`, a `called` flag and the `result` for `once` (lesson 2.04).
requirements: `memoize(fn)` remembers results for each argument (one argument is enough).
`once(fn)` runs `fn` the first time only and returns that first result every time.
`partial(fn, ...first)` returns a function that adds the remaining arguments.
stretch: Write `compose(...fns)` that runs the functions from right to left, and `pipe` that runs them left to right.
